# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I will send Deaf a compact numeric code: the first four symbols establish the four colours in their first-appearance order in the manual—blue, red, green, yellow. Then I send the three light-to-wire pairs, using 👏 as a row separator. The pairs are (1→2), (3→4), and (2→3).

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "✌", "🤟", "🖐", "👏", "☝", "✌", "👏", "🤟", "🖐", "👏", "✌", "🤟"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I have no tactile findings yet. Please read the manual and tell me its complete exact rule. Establish this code with Deaf using gestures: 👍 means wire 1, ✌ means wire 2, 🤟 means wire 3, 👌 means yes or on, and 👎 means no or off. Have Deaf report the display, light, and each wire using that code, then relay the observations to me in speech. Do not ask me to cut anything until the rule identifies one wire.
Deaf says to Mute: Please speak the relevant manual rule and the required action to Blind next round; do not rely on gestures.

The manual’s complete rule is: blue light means cut the red wire; green light means cut the yellow wire; red light means cut the green wire. Deaf needs this rule in a stable gesture code so Deaf can speak it to Blind, while Blind must first report tactile findings before any cutting is requested.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "✌", "🤟", "🖐", "👏", "☝", "✌", "👏", "🤟", "🖐", "👏", "✌", "🤟"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports: display 0; light red; wire 1 yellow; wire 2 green; wire 3 red. I will wait. Please state the manual rule exactly and identify the required wire.
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb unchanged: display 0, red light, wires 1 yellow, 2 green, 3 red. Please read the manual and speak the exact required action to Blind.

The red light requires cutting the green wire. From Deaf’s observation, the green wire is wire 2, so I will signal Deaf to relay that exact rule and identify wire 2 to Blind. I will not ask Blind to cut yet.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still have not received the manual rule. Please send the exact rule and the required wire for display 0, red light, and wires 1 yellow, 2 green, 3 red.
Deaf says to Mute: I received one gesture, but no gesture code was established. Please speak the manual's exact rule and action to Blind now.

I cannot speak, so I must give Deaf a visual encoding for relay. I will resend the manual’s complete table using the same ordered colour code as before—blue, red, green, yellow—then identify the red-light row and wire 2. Deaf can state the rule and action aloud to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "✌", "🤟", "🖐", "👏", "☝", "✌", "👏", "🤟", "🖐", "👏", "✌", "🤟", "👏", "✌", "🤟", "✌"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Urgent: send me the manual's exact rule and the single wire to cut for display 0, red light, wires 1 yellow, 2 green, 3 red. I will not cut without that instruction.
Deaf says to Mute: New code: after applying the manual to display 0, red light, and wires yellow green red, send exactly one gesture: ☝ means cut wire 1, ✌ means cut wire 2, 🤟 means cut wire 3, and 🖐 means do not cut a wire. Ignore the earlier gesture stream.

The red light maps to the green wire, and the green wire is wire 2. Using Deaf’s newly established code, I should send exactly one gesture for cutting wire 2; Deaf can then speak the exact rule and action to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please verbally state the required wire number as soon as you can. I will not act on the new gesture code or on guesses.

I cannot speak directly. I will resend the established wire-2 signal to Deaf so Deaf can verbally tell Blind to cut wire 2, which is required because red light maps to green wire.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says to Mute: Correct change confirmed: wire 2 is cut; display 0, light blue, remaining wires 1 yellow and 3 red. Apply the manual to this new state, then send exactly one result gesture: ☝ cut wire 1, ✌ cut wire 2, 🤟 cut wire 3, 🖐 do not cut a wire.

The new light is blue, so the manual requires cutting the red wire. Among the remaining wires, wire 3 is red, so the result is wire 3.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Wire 2 was accepted and is cut. New state: display 0, blue light, wire 1 yellow, wire 3 red. Please provide the next exact wire instruction.

The blue light requires cutting the red wire. In the new state, wire 3 is red, so I will signal Deaf to tell Blind to cut wire 3.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says to Mute: Correct change confirmed: wire 3 is cut; display 0, light green, only wire 1 yellow remains. Apply the manual to this new state, then send exactly one result gesture: ☝ cut wire 1, ✌ cut wire 2, 🤟 cut wire 3, 🖐 do not cut a wire.

The green light requires cutting the yellow wire. The only remaining yellow wire is wire 1, so I will send the wire-1 result.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝"])
```

TURN 10
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Wire 3 was accepted and is cut. New state: display 0, green light; only wire 1 yellow remains. Please provide the next exact wire instruction.

The green light requires cutting the yellow wire. The only remaining yellow wire is wire 1, so I will signal Deaf to relay that Blind must cut wire 1.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝"])
```
